# Kuailu Technology Visible AI+ Power 2026, One-stop AI Smart Office Enabling Global Enterprise Digitalization

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Published: 2026-06-08
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202606/08/WS6a268b19a310942cc49b09fc.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202606/08/WS6a268b19a310942cc49b09fc.html]

## Text
Agenic AI is moving from concept to industry. On 4-5 June, Kuailu Technology participated in Hong Kong's largest commercial AI exhibition - AI+ Power 2026. The fair served as a key window for global AI technology and programme exchanges, bringing together a number of global AI industry chains, attracting nearly 10,000 guests, industry experts and practitioners from foreign and domestic politics.

Kuailu Technology, as an AI Smart Office pioneer, showcases its forward-looking layout and rich practices in smart office lanes to provide an entirely new paradigm for global corporate office intelligent development with ready-to-be AI applications, scenario programmes and mature AI governance, business methodology.

The exhibition was organized in an intense industry environment, with many political and business guests, business digital directors and industry practitioners visiting Kuailu ' s exhibition space and in-depth exchanges with teams on the core issues of AI smart application and office smartness.

Kuailu7 Mainstream office scene programme

To cover business needs with AI+

Building on Hong Kong's internationalized territorial advantage and the dividends of the Government's “AI+” industrial development strategy, the exhibition focused in depth on the digital transformational pains of the real economy and promoted the development of AI technology from a fragmentation pilot application to a systemic, full-link, profitable scale landing. But, in combination with the actual scenario, there are still common problems in the application of AI within an enterprise, such as low business integration, low intellectualization and lack of security governance, and how can AI ' s productivity be truly unleashed?

The answer to Kuailu Technology is: one-stop AI smart office, which covers seven main mainstream office scenarios, such as finance, personnel, administration, procurement, CRM, instant messaging, meetings, etc., and combines AI core technology, such as smart generation, smart search and generating decision-making skills, so that the firm can quickly align AI with the depth of its business and move into smart office models of smart decision-making, smart execution, closed delivery.

Take the example of AI-CRM: Kuailu AI-CRM, as an AI primary product, solidifies the four basic modules of clues, customers, businesses, and orders, and penetrates AI deep into the whole business, building an AI smart toolbox with nine open boxes, covering the recipients, follow-up, quotations, collaboration, management of the whole business, allowing companies to see the dynamics of sales in real time from the perspective of their global operations, studying the risks of their operations, and automatically generating a war strategy.

Take the example of KuailuAI+HR, which covers the entire life cycle of the enterprise's personnel management "selection-use-bearing-retention" while freeing HR from service work through full process automation and AI intelligence.

(b) Support for the flexible set-up of multi-organizational structures, the digitization of staff movement away from full-scale migration, job-level intelligence control, and direct reduction of 80 per cent in manual desk account operations; and the recruitment end: smart recruitment management brings back the first key, interview line up, offer automatically generated and recruitment cycle reduced by an average of 40 per cent;

Kuailu2 Large AI primary product

Create an exclusive digital employee for the enterprise

The year 2026 is Agent AI ' s commercial year of scale, and the smart body with the ability to understand, organize, implement and deliver in closed circles is becoming the core infrastructure for the digitalization of enterprises. This exhibition, Kuailu Technology's two core AI primary products, Kuailu Claw's Smart Body Platform, and AI field experts, achieved full coverage of the standardized office scene and innovative business scene with the core attributes of natural language interaction, multi-intellectual synergy, and business closed circle delivery.

In response to a standardized scenario with low error rates and high professional requirements within the enterprise, Kuailu Technology provides in-depth analysis specialists, compliance review experts, financial management specialists, document generation specialists, human resources specialists and smart guest specialists, which accumulates six leading AI-based expert specimens, providing access to internal and external data, integrating business knowledge, and matching flexible workflows, allowing AI to fit business logic in depth and to produce accurate decision-making results.

The Kuailu Claw, as an enterprise-level AI primary office platform, can easily perform automated tasks, simplify processes within the IM system, and make Kuailu Claw become 24h in-post digitally separate and focus on creation and exploration. The built-in prefabricated Skill library, which includes multiple enterprise-level high-frequency scenarios, such as finance, personnel, compliance and so forth, is ready to be installed. It is more supportive of internal Skill self-defined and upstretched, settling in-house raw skills and converting them into intra-enterprise assets.

To date, the KLTECHTERRAI original solution has been scaled up to the commercial site, serving over 1,000 commercial, manufacturing and modern service enterprises around the world, with a cumulative number of over 200 intelligent digital projects. Kuailu Technology has become a core service provider in the area of enterprise-level AI office infrastructure, based on stable technical capacity, well-developed delivery systems and experience with the landing of mature industries.

Kuailu ' s global landscape of deep tillage, enabling industrial intellectual upgrading

The presentation of the Hong Kong AI+Power 2026 International Fair is an important layout for Kuailu Technology ' s strategy to deepen globalization and integrate international AI industrial ecology. Currently, Kuailu Technology has established its headquarters in more than a dozen regions, including Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Hong Kong and Singapore, building on the ability of the Globalisation Service Network to deliver locally, accelerating the deep integration of AI technology with the office industry, providing high-fit and off-site AI digital solutions for enterprises, and contributing to a high-quality quantitative and intellectual transformation of the global industry. Welcome to Kuailu TechnologyGZH.
